author: ForrestKnight
description:
Microservices solved a problem that most companies never had.

Try out PostHog, it's genuinely awesome (and a lot of fun!): https://jetty.to/posthog

So I've covered Netflix's engineering a couple times before, and one of the biggest things they've done was migrating to microservices. It was perfect for them, and it worked out so well that the rest of the industry followed suit. However, there's just one problem there... most of these other companies never even knew the problem they were copying the solution to.

Sources:
Four Reasons We Choose Amazon's Cloud as Our Computing Platform (Netflix, Dec 2010): https://netflixtechblog.com/four-reasons-we-choose-amazons-cloud-as-our-computing-platform-4aceb692afec

title: Why Your Company Copied Netflix's Architecture
